patch_description:
This crossover version keeps the best parts of the prior feature sets while shifting the model toward shorter, more regime-robust signals. I reduced reliance on long lookbacks, added rolling z-score normalization, and emphasized change-in-market-character features such as volatility trend, autocorrelation trend, efficiency trend, and momentum scaled by volatility regime.

On the model side, I eased the over-regularization that was causing prediction collapse by using a slightly deeper tree, lower min_child_weight, milder L1/L2, and a learning rate / estimator mix that should preserve expressivity while still controlling overfit. The feature set remains comfortably under the 80-feature limit and uses only past data.
